# AutoCaption Studio

> Free AI video caption generator for Hindi, Hinglish, English and 25+ languages. Upload a video, get word-by-word animated captions, edit them in the browser, and export a captioned MP4 or an SRT subtitle file.

## Main page
- [AutoCaption Studio](https://caption-generator-9ch5.onrender.com/): Free AI video caption generator with word-level timing, animated caption styles and MP4/SRT export.

## Features
- [AI transcription](https://caption-generator-9ch5.onrender.com/#features): Whisper and Gemini generate word-by-word captions with accurate timing.
- [Supported languages](https://caption-generator-9ch5.onrender.com/#languages): Hindi, Hinglish, English, Punjabi, Haryanvi, Bhojpuri, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Urdu, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Assamese, Odia, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Portuguese, Italian and Turkish.
- [How it works](https://caption-generator-9ch5.onrender.com/#how-it-works): Upload, auto-generate captions, style and export in three steps.
- [FAQ](https://caption-generator-9ch5.onrender.com/#faq): Answers about pricing, accuracy, privacy, formats and SRT downloads.

## Use cases
- Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok captions
- Podcasts, interviews and talking-head videos
- Online courses and tutorials
- Ads, product demos and promotional videos

## Notes
- The app is free, requires no sign-up, and does not add a watermark.
- MP4, MOV, WEBM, M4V, MKV, MP3, WAV and M4A files up to 1 GB are supported.
- Exports: MP4 with burned-in captions, or a standard .srt subtitle file.
